description: This file defines a PHP class 'Trim' within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing methods for string cleaning operations such as removing non-printable characters and trimming spaces.

classes.name: Trim
classes.description: A utility class for string trimming and cleaning operations within the PhpSpreadsheet Calculation TextData namespace.

methods.name: nonPrintable
methods.description: Removes non-printable ASCII characters from a string or array of strings.

methods.name: spaces
methods.description: Trims leading and trailing spaces, and reduces multiple spaces inside the string to a single space.
